Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling eastbound and attempting a left turn at an intersection in Sugar Land, Texas, when the front of
the vehicle was struck by Driver 2, whose vehicle had been proceeding straight through the intersection. Driver 1 is
listed as the named insured on the policy under which this vehicle is insured, and that status was confirmed at the
scene. The Passenger was seated in the front passenger seat and was present in the vehicle at the time of impact, a
fact confirmed by both drivers and by responding officers. Driver 1 reported neck strain and stated that the pain
began shrotly afetr the collision. Damage to the front bumper, hood, and driver-side headlamp assembly is consistent
with the impact described by both parties. Photographs taken at the scene verify several of these details. No
independent witnesses were located, and no prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle was known to either driver or
observed by responding officers. At this time it is not yet clear whether the reported neck injury resulted from this
collision, and no medical evaluation has been completed. Follow-up is recommended.
</page>

Rate each feature below that THIS page gives evidence about. Leave out a feature the page

- injury_crash_fit: Does the claimed injury fit the type and force of the crash? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occurrence_support: Do independent sources (witnesses, photos, cameras, the other driver) confirm that the accident happened as described? Allowed: Confirmed, Partially corroborated, Uncorroborated, Contradicted, Suspected staged.
- damage_crash_fit: Does the vehicle damage fit the described impact? Allowed: Strong, Reasonable, Unclear, Inconsistent.
- occupant_presence: Was the claimant really in the vehicle at the time of the crash? Allowed: Verified, Unclear, Added later, Not present.
- occupants_listed: How many people does the police report list in the insured vehicle (Vehicle 1)? The rating is a whole number. Allowed: a whole number.
- prior_damage_evidence: Is there evidence of vehicle damage from before this crash? Allowed: None, Possible, Documented, Material.
- driver_status: Is the driver of the insured vehicle on the policy? Allowed: Listed, Household, Unlisted, Excluded.
